versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* fix: say when a JS source fails to load instead of showing it as empty by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/921
* fix: restore bundled TLS roots so Android stops panicking on HTTPS by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/920
* fix: track anime on Simkl as anime, not as a TV show by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/932
* Use correct image extensions by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/926
* fix: stop the library disposing a TabController the tabs still paint from by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/930
* fix: say why AniList refused, stop asking, and fall back where we can by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/911
* fix: only file things that belong in the tracker by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/919
* fix: stop using the player after the reader has left it by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/931
* feat: a live memory readout, so the TV questions can be measured by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/929
* feat: TV is only asked for source and nothing else on the welcome screen cus anime only gate now by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/938
* feat: show what a title is related to, and open it in your sources by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/939
* feat: show which account a tracker is signed in to, and fix the id sent as a name by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/940
* perf(tv): show only the tab the television is on by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/941
* fix: say why a global search had nothing to search by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/943
* fix: raise the two things sitting under a minimum by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/945
* refactor: one definition for the alpha ladder by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/946
* fix: pure black dark mode was not pure, and not black by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/947
* refactor: the chapter dialog follows the theme by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/948
* fix: a season is part of which chapter a chapter is by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/950
* fix: stop telling Linux to use a resolver it does not have by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/952
* Add DbWriteQueue + repository layer, migrate all from raws DB logics into Repositories Logic  by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/954
* refactor: one row of pills on the detail page, not a column of buttons by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/942
* fix: the novel reader's controller is gone by the time dispose needs it by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/955
* feat: catch the crashes Dart cannot see by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/913


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.8.9...v0.9.0
